Updated all references from `exodus712` to `squidllee`:

- git remote → `https://github.com/squidllee/punch-in.git`

Note: the remote URL change only takes effect if the repo itself was renamed/transferred on GitHub — if the repo still lives under the old account, pushes will fail.
